name: search-3
title: Grouped Command Palette
description: Command style search panel grouping results into Pages, People, and Files with icons, avatars, and meta, plus keyboard hints in the footer.

standards.purpose: Help someone find a known item fast, including when nothing matches.
useWhen: The corpus is too large to browse by navigation.
doNotUseWhen: There are fewer than a handful of items to choose from.

rules.check: The query input has an accessible label and search semantics.
The no-results state states what was searched and suggests a next step.
Result counts update with the query and are announced politely.
